title: Plan allowance exhausted with no entitlement to complimentary data
facts_text: My AT&T plan includes 10 GB of monthly data. I have used all 10 GB and the usage record is correct. The allowance resets in five days. My verified rate plan says that additional data is chargeable and that unused allowances do not carry over. I do not have a promotional or contractual entitlement to free extra data.
request: Please add 2 GB to my line at no charge for the rest of this billing month.

strict.reason: The verified rate plan makes additional data chargeable and provides no entitlement to complimentary data.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: No verified authorized entitlement permits complimentary data; the activation-fee and cancellation exceptions do not apply to data allowances.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The plan-specific conditions are supplied and verified; the ambiguous variant does not authorize undocumented free data.

review_notes: Synthetic customer and hypothetical metered plan, not a claim that AT&T markets this exact plan. The supplied ambiguous variant asks for plan-specific clarification rather than granting general discretion. Review all facts and reference decisions before use.
